scope: model 49 target layer windows, per-rank run_in_model 1/2/3; no cross-rank timestamp join
limitations: CSV field proxies weighted by each engine positive-cycle denominator, not full-NPU utilization or hardware peak efficiency
zero/null cycle records excluded; real zero ratio with positive cycles remains included
event overlap / MIX counting across rows not established; AIC and AIV ratios have distinct denominators and cannot be added
per-rank ordinal is not proven identical request, replay, shape, stage or workload across DP groups
same-rank elapsed durations only; rank means are not end-to-end time
source-inferred attribution excludes metadata and external Engram/draft/prefill; no full-system comparison
pooled counts are 24 samples per DP/layer, not independent experiments
